description: Get a TRON block by number or latest. Use include_transactions to get transaction details with decoded contract data (sender, receiver, amounts) and pagination.

include_transactions.description: Include decoded transaction details with contract data — sender, receiver, amounts (default: false)

limit.description: Max transactions to return when include_transactions is true (default: 50)

offset.description: Skip first N transactions (default: 0, for pagination)

name: get_block
